identifierMapping.rule: The official metadata.cell_names array contains epSanyo002 through epSanyo049 in ascending order. Registered cell n maps to metadata.cell_names[n-1].

capacityMapping.testOrder: Sort immediate TS* test directories lexicographically; their zero-padded numeric identifiers preserve chronology. EIS subdirectories do not contain capacity or aging-cycle rows.
capacityMapping.cycleConstruction: Starting at zero, add every finite subcycles value before recording a capacity row. For multiple finite CapDCH1 values at the same cumulative cycle, use their median.
capacityMapping.bol: The first finite capacity row at cumulative cycle zero.
capacityMapping.firstRpt: The earliest finite capacity row at a strictly positive cumulative cycle.
capacityMapping.response: log(CapDCH1_firstRpt/CapDCH1_bol) divided by the first-RPT cumulative cycle.
capacityMapping.event: The first later capacity row at or below 0.80 times CapDCH1_bol; otherwise right-censor at the final later capacity row.

evidence: The official pulse.mat structure exposes resistance, Ah_act, Duration, and Current.
Both pilot cells expose only Duration values 2 and 10.
The official PlotPulseResistance.m example sets PulseLength=2 and labels the result as 2-second pulse resistance, confirming that Duration is expressed in seconds.
No 0.01-second observation exists in either pilot, so a 10 ms coordinate cannot be formed without changing the registered feature.
pulseMapping.consequence: Arm C and H2 are declared unavailable before non-pilot results. A 2-second or 10-second substitute is prohibited. Arm A and the preregistered capacity-response Arm B remain unchanged.
